_comment: Names pinned to the daily shortlist. They are scored exactly like every other stock and are NOT given a bonus - they simply always surface, with their real score and true rank, even when they do not earn a top-20 slot. Remove a name by deleting its entry. Read by tools/build_shortlist.py, which emits them as doc.watchlist.
